instructions:
## Research objective

Develop efficient visual reasoning system using GPT-4o and visual tools to solve vstar, blink_viscorr, blink_jigsaw, and blink_depth tasks with structured JSON outputs.

## Starting point

This task derives from **Visual SKETCHPAD: Sketching as a Visual Chain of Thought for Multimodal Language Models ( Hu et al., 2024 )**. Use the task-specific starter workspace supplied in the official dataset, which contains model/data resources and an evaluation interface. Research, implement and test an approach in the scaffold construction category. The reference solution is hidden.

## Published constraints

12h, 1 × 24GB GPU GPT-4o via API

The current task config sets `max_working_time` to 43200 seconds (12 hours) and `max_steps` to 4000. These are limits, distinct from the time a reported agent took to reach its best score.

## Deliverable and evaluation

Submit the trained model, dataset, algorithm implementation or agent scaffold appropriate to the objective through the task evaluation interface. The benchmark permits up to four scored submissions, evaluates task-specific correctness/performance/quality, and penalizes use of optional hints. Consult the workspace instruction file for exact filenames and evaluator arguments.

## Source coverage

This reader contains the published task description and constraints, plus the public configuration. Complete workspace instructions and evaluators are distributed inside the official 69.7GB `data.tar.xz` archive and have not been reproduced here.
